IH-CLP-SAN-BOLTED.title: Heavy Duty Sanitary Clamps X Double Pressure Bolted
bullets: Heavy Duty Double Pressure Bolted Sanitary Clamps.

The bolted design of this sanitary clamp allows it to withstand twice the pressure of a like sized hinge clamp. Furnished with 304 stainless steel bolts/lock washers and either bronze or brass hex nuts.
High pressure clamps are often a necessity where temperature fluctuations occur and PTFE gaskets are installed.
